page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. It does not feature local storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance evaluations indicate that the underlying CPU and memory subsystems operate in lower performance tiers compared to modern hardware. The single-core stress-ng benchmark score of 953.38 falls into the bottom 10%, while the multi-core score of 4755.08 is in the bottom 25%. PassMark CPU testing yields an average score of 6698.53, though extended instructions, encryption, and physics tests fall into the bottom 25%. Memory performance is also constrained, with a PassMark memory score of 1780.34 and large-block read bandwidth of 37.18 GB/sec. Redis SET operations achieve 5.48 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput is measured at 6.06 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents a legacy GPU tier. It offers dedicated CPU resources and hardware acceleration at a lower entry point than newer GPU architectures, making it suitable for workloads where high-end compute density is not required. The absence of local storage means all data must reside on network-attached volumes. This instance is best suited for entry-level GPU workloads such as small-scale inference, video transcoding, basic CUDA development, and lightweight parallel processing tasks that benefit from GPU acceleration but do not demand high CPU or memory bandwidth.
